explication: TEESimulator is a privileged Android module that routes selected apps’ KeyMint operations through an in-process software TA, while leaving other keys on hardware. Its daemon harvests device identity, resolves profile configuration, injects and configures native interceptors, and supports live reconfiguration and WebUI administration. The graph preserves both Android keystore generations, attestation/keybox stages, and documented management capabilities. Some subsystem links are README-backed because their implementation files were not excerpted.
